falsification_conditions.condition: SPX closes above 5,600 on any day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A new all-time high would invalidate the bottom_2024_aug pattern match, as that pattern resolved with lower lows; this would signal the 'bottom' already occurred and we're in a new uptrend, making the HOLD signal incorrect

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 14.00 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Sustained complacency at pre-correction levels would falsify the bottoming narrative; the pattern requires elevated volatility during accumulation, and this would indicate the market never actually capitulated

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.80% while SPX simultaneously trades below 5,200
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A flight-to-safety bid in bonds alongside equity weakness would indicate recession panic rather than a tactical bottom, breaking the pattern's requirement for rates stabilizing or rising during the equity floor formation

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
